svg.title: Building a path in a loop
svg.desc: An animation of a 4 by 4 grid with Python beside it. First, path = [] and a for loop over range(1, 4): on each pass x is 1, 2, then 3, a red dot steps one intersection to the right, the tuple (x, 0) is appended, and a new box joins the list, numbered 0, 1, 2. The start (0, 0) is ringed and never added. len(path) is 3. Then two loops one after the other: a go-right loop appends (1, 0) and (2, 0), and a go-up loop appends (2, 1), (2, 2) and (2, 3): the path from (0, 0) to (2, 3), five steps.
svg.text: Building a path in a loop
Start empty, append inside a loop: the
list grows by one on every pass, and
the start is never in it.

g.text: append (1, 0): the list grows by one
append (2, 0): the list grows by one
append (3, 0): the list grows by one
three places to drive to: three steps
